title: Maintenance & Recovery
summary: Repair and clean-up tools for the system module. The same module also powers the read-only Hardware & Resource Status screen (main menu option 5), which shows architecture, OpenWrt release, RAM and storage usage.

items.title: Purge DayPass Installed Packages
items.description: Reads the install log and removes every package DayPass installed, after confirmation.
items.usage_tip: Useful before reinstalling with a different package manager or release.

items.title: Clean Temporary Cache & Downloads
items.description: Deletes leftover .ipk, .apk and .part files from the DayPass directory.
items.usage_tip: Run it before a large install to free flash space.

items.title: Backup System Configuration
items.description: Creates a timestamped sysupgrade archive of the current OpenWrt configuration in /tmp.
items.usage_tip: Copy the archive off the router: /tmp does not survive a reboot.

items.title: Factory Reset OpenWrt (Firstboot)
items.description: Erases all user configuration and reboots the router with clean defaults.
items.usage_tip: You must type RESET to confirm. There is no undo.

items.title: Back to Main Menu
items.description: Returns to the main DayPass menu.
items.usage_tip: Nothing is removed while using this option.
